categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically dealing with government acquisition of land for public purposes (Village Secretariat maintenance and DS Office construction). The content focuses on land descriptions, extents, locations, and compensation procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
